CBSE Opens Registration for Class 12 Supplementary Exams

The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has commenced the process for Class 12 Supplementary Exams in 2026. Registration, including a third chance for private candidates, is now open on the Pariksha Sangam portal. The deadline for submitting the List of Candidates (LOC) has been set for July 8.
